name: edunusa
description: Platform EduNusa — root workspace (backend, frontend, ai-service)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,backend,frontend -c yellow,blue,green "npm run db" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w frontend && concurrently -n db,backend -c yellow,blue "npm run db" "npm run start -w backend"
